snippet.title: I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother: Noah Smalljohnson's Puzzle Game [They Made Another One!]
snippet.description:
I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother Presents: Noah Smalljohnson's Puzzle Game is a unique puzzle/FMV by Kimulator's Films - A followup to the amazing 'I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother'. Yes, they made another one... Not the game we need, but the game we deserve!!!! It's great to see more game elements and some new songs! The talk show at the start is a bit weird (SKIP TO 9:45!!!) but the puzzle gameplay after that is cool. Get it on PlayStation store here: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP7605-CUSA43174_00-0424463570431991 .

#ps4 #puzzlegame  @KimulatorsFilms
